Disha Salian death case: Advocate submits new evidence to CBI

Advocate Nilesh Ojha has submitted a new piece of evidence to the Central Bureau of Investigation (CBI) in connection with the death of Disha Salian. Ojha is seeking the custodial interrogation of the accused. He also stated an intention to file a fresh petition.
